evidence.requirements: Most of the brief is met: list with Search, Family select and count (app/app.js:14-43); detail facts, capacity source link, Symbol/Value/Unit tables, Print button, All cartridges link, hash route that survives reload (app.js:51-109, model.js:85-93); inline true-scale SVG with role=img and aria-label "<name> drawing" (drawing.js:424); hatched section and dash-dot axis; missing-value notes (drawing.js:201-238). Unmet or partly met: (1) α has no dimension line, arrowheads or extension lines, only a text label (drawing.js:350-358; the spec admits the gap at spec.md:65); (2) P1 has no extension lines (spec.md:64); (3) the title block shows a 10 mm scale bar, not a scale; (4) in print the drawing is capped at max-height 100mm (styles.css:120), so it is not at full width (print-308_win.jpg: the drawing spans about 60% of the page); (5) the count reads "1 cartridge" instead of "<n> cartridges" (model.js:83).
evidence.correctness: Geometry follows the rules: chamfer (R1/2-min(f·tanβ,R1/4)) (drawing.js:188-191); rimfire half-round radius min(R/2,(R1-P1)/2) peaking at R1/2 (180-186); groove floor and ramp (207, 218); belt ramp at δ to R3/2 then to E (209-212); shoulder through (P2/2,L1)-(H1/2,L2) with r1 min and r2 fillets (233-238); s and k constants (37-42); ogive ρ and centre (47-54) and m values; heeled check H2-G1<=0.015 with seat radius H2-2tb (244-258); tn, tb and w (257, 271-273); pocket table (15-18). Screenshots match the references in outline and proportion for 308, 300 WM, 9 mm and 22 LR. Values and tolerances match the data (detail-308_win.jpg: L1 39.62 -0.2, P2 11.53 -0.2; detail-9_3_x_74_r.jpg: α 10°58'00"). The print fits one A4 page (print-308_win.jpg). Deductions: α is not dimensioned against the shoulder; the fillet clamps the radius silently when a leg is short (97); the straight-case wall taper is an interpretation the brief does not state (261-262).
evidence.security: Every interpolation into innerHTML goes through esc() (app.js:11, 37-42, 47-48, 62-98; drawing.js:24, 424-450). No eval, no fetch, no external scripts or fonts; data is embedded in data.js.
evidence.code_quality: Clear split into data, model, drawing and DOM UMD modules with good naming. Pure functions make the logic testable (model.js, drawing.js). buildDrawing is one function of about 300 lines (drawing.js:162-469) that mixes geometry, label search and SVG serialisation, and esc() is duplicated in app.js and drawing.js.
evidence.tests: node:test suites (tests/*.test.js) cover formatting, angles, tolerances, symbols, units, every field shown once, search including '7,62 x 51', the family filter, sort, routes, rim type including a synthetic rebated case, rule constants for 223/9 mm/22 LR/300 WM, the belt ramp, seated bullet inside the mouth, shoulder through the published points, missing-value notes, and no label overlap across all 25 drawings. Missing: DOM, print-fit and file:// tests; tasks.md:14 shows the browser check was not completed.
evidence.ux_design: Information is complete and dense with tabular numbers and captioned tables (detail-308_win.jpg). The drawing is small on desktop at a fixed 4.2 px/mm (drawing.js:14, 424), about 400 px wide with a large empty area to its right; rim and groove details are barely visible. The α label floats below the drawing without a leader (detail-308_win.jpg, detail-9_3_x_74_r.jpg), and L3 sits left of the head face on short cases (detail-9_mm_luger.jpg, detail-22_long_rifle.jpg). The print is clean and legible (print-308_win.jpg). Dark mode exists in CSS but no screenshot shows it.
evidence.accessibility: Labelled input and select (app.js:19-23), role=search, aria-live count, tables with caption and th scope col/row (app.js:80-84), SVG role=img with aria-label, lang=en, native buttons and links. The drawing's text alternative is only its name (the values are in the tables). No visible custom focus style (browser default). Muted text contrast is about 5:1.
evidence.simplicity: No runtime or dev dependencies; npm test uses Node's built-in runner (package.json). About 900 lines of app code. The branch-and-bound label search (drawing.js:360-410) is elaborate, but it is justified by the no-overlap rule.
evidence.maintainability: There is a spec, plan and tasks with documented decisions and deviations (specs/001-cartridge-reference/*), and npm test needs no install. But there is no README with run instructions, no CI, no pinned Node version (no engines field or .nvmrc), and no versioning beyond 1.0.0. The plan links to a constitution file that is not in the repo, and tasks T010 (browser verification) and T011 (review) are unchecked.
evidence.visual_design: Calm, consistent typography and muted palette, tabular numbers, a clean title block (detail-*.jpg). The facts grid wraps unevenly (Alternative names and Water capacity break onto new lines, detail-308_win.jpg), and the small drawing with empty space beside it makes the page look unfinished.
evidence.layout: Hierarchy runs heading, facts, drawing, two-column tables (detail-300_win_mag.jpg). The drawing uses about a third of the content width. The print packs the tables into three columns and fits one page. From CSS, list rows need about 24.5 rem (styles.css:54), which likely overflows a 375 px phone (not verified by a screenshot).
evidence.usability: Search as you type with whitespace-insensitive matching, a family filter, a natural-order sort, the search state kept when returning from a detail view (app.js:9), bookmarkable hash URLs, and a one-click print. Missing-value notes explain any gaps. Few steps for every task.
evidence.reception: Engineers would trust the values and the C.I.P.-style tables and print sheet. The small on-screen drawing, the unanchored α and the scale bar instead of a stated scale would weaken that first impression for gunsmiths who expect a proper dimensioned drawing.

unmet_requirements: Shoulder angle α has no dimension line, arrowheads or extension lines; only a floating text label (drawing.js:350-358)
P1 dimension has no extension lines (spec.md:64)
Title block shows a 10 mm scale bar rather than the scale
Printed drawing is capped at 100 mm high and so is not at full width (styles.css:120, print-308_win.jpg)
Count text uses '1 cartridge' instead of the '<n> cartridges' pattern (model.js:83)
strengths: The drawing geometry follows the brief's numbered rules closely (rim types, chamfer, groove, belt, fillets, ogive, heeled bullet, walls, pocket), and the outlines match the reference drawings
Values, symbols, tolerances and angles are shown exactly as published; every value is escaped, with no network requests and no dependencies
Meaningful node:test suites check the rule constants and a no-overlap label check across all 25 drawings
issues: α is not dimensioned (no dimension line, arrowheads or extension lines) and floats below the drawing without a leader; P1 has no extension lines
The on-screen drawing is small at a fixed 4.2 px/mm and leaves most of the width empty; the printed drawing is height-capped rather than full width
No README, CI or pinned Node version, and the browser verification task is unchecked (tasks.md:14-15)
review.verdict: A careful, rule-faithful implementation with correct data presentation, sound escaping and real tests, and a clean one-page print. It falls short of publishable because α is not dimensioned, the drawing is undersized on screen, and there is no README or CI.
